text:
Maya Patel: morning — planning to cut the RC candidate (rc/v1.8.0-candidate) at 11:30 PT. quick health check: please post one-line status + blockers. if you're doing any cherrypicks, drop PRs.
Samir Khan: +1. working on the batching perf fix. PR #3941 is ready but CI has one flaky failure in `ci/integration:kv-cache`. rerunning now.
Cheng Li: cherrypick queued: #3892 -> rc branch (backport quantization config). ran unit tests locally, all good. no blockers.
Leo Martínez: I pushed #3955 (docs + console airflow tweak) — non-blocking. main blocker is a merge conflict on the routing layer with Samir's perf branch; I'll wait for his rebase or will rebase mine after he merges.
Samir Khan: rebase incoming in ~10m. the kv-cache CI failure looks like a timing flake — adding an extra sleep in test to stabilize. if it still flakes i'll drop a rollback patch for the test only.
Ava (oncall): FYI the canary in us-west-2 started showing elevated 5xxs around 02:12 UTC, looks tied to a recent kernel update on the pool nodes. infra rolling patch now, should be resolved in ~15m. :construction_worker:
Maya Patel: thanks — canary 5xxs could block cut if they persist past 11:10 PT. Ava please call it out if not green by then.
Cheng Li: one note on backports: #3892 changes model compilation flags. QA found a perf delta on long-seq tests (+6% p99). i'm adding a guard so rc still uses the previous kernel if regression > 5%. will PR to rc branch.
Samir Khan: status update: CI rerun passed on primary, failing job retried and passed. i'm merging #3941 now. will create a follow-up hotfix if the canary 5xxs reappear after infra patch.
releasebot: [deploy] Started canary rollout rc/v1.8.0-candidate -> us-west-2 (5 instances).
Leo Martínez: quick ask — can we hold non-essential cherrypicks after 11:00 PT? saves another round of rebuilds.
Maya Patel: agree. hold non-critical cherrypicks after 11:00 PT. only bugfix/backports that are blocking should go in.
Ava (oncall): infra patch completed, canary metrics back to baseline. 5xx rate down to normal. :thumbsup:
Samir Khan: merged #3941. no outstanding blocking PRs from my side.
Cheng Li: opened guard PR to rc: #3960 (uses older kernel flags when p99 delta > 5%). request review from @Maya.
Maya Patel: reviewing #3960 now. if green i'll approve.
Leo Martínez: squashed my doc commits into one PR and will hold until after cut.
Maya Patel: current cut plan unchanged — proceeding to cut at 11:30 PT unless any regression appears in the next 20m. last call for urgent cherrypicks.
Samir Khan: last call: none from me.
Cheng Li: none urgent.
Leo Martínez: none.
Ava (oncall): monitoring canaries for 30m post-cut. will ping if anything changes.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone. will post final cut confirmation here when done.
releasebot: [deploy] rc/v1.8.0-candidate image built: sha256:abc123... and tagged.
Maya Patel: CUT DONE — rc/v1.8.0-candidate published at 11:31 PT. rolling to staging and canaries now. :tada:
Ava (oncall): staging green. canaries running, no regressions so far.
